style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: व्यदारयत्, split, literally means to rip open
the sound reaches from the sky to the earth
the sound of the Pandava conches terrifies the Kauravas
candidates.evidence: घोषो ... धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत् (sound ... split the hearts of Dhritarashtra's sons)

angle_en: Vyadarayat, to rip open the hearts

en.intro: The Pandava conches sound, and the noise is so fierce it seems to shake the very ground. Listen for who it strikes.
en.notice: The word vyadarayat means to rip open or split. The sound of the Pandava conches rips open the hearts of Dhritarashtra's sons before a single weapon is lifted.
en.next: Yet Arjuna, the source of this sound, does not stand in joy. He lifts his bow, ready to fight.
en.next_alt: The Pandava conches have struck fear into the Kauravas, yet Arjuna lifts his bow to begin the war.
en.meaning: That terrible sound split the hearts of Dhritarashtra's side, echoing through sky and earth.

hi.intro: पाण्डव सेना के शंख बजते हैं और वह शोर इतना भयंकर है कि जैसे धरती ही हिल जाए। ध्यान से सुनिए कि यह शोर किसे डरा रहा है।
hi.meaning: पाण्डव सेना के शंखों की वह भयंकर आवाज़ आकाश और पृथ्वी को गुँजाती हुई धृतराष्ट्र के पुत्रों के हृदय चीर गई।
hi.notice: व्यदारयत् शब्द का अर्थ है फाड़ देना। पाण्डवों के शंखों की आवाज़ ने कौरवों के दिलों को फाड़ दिया, इससे पहले कि कोई हथियार छूटा भी नहीं।
hi.next: फिर भी अर्जुन, जो इस शोर के कारण हैं, खुशी से नहीं खड़े हैं। वे अपना धनुष उठाते हैं, युद्ध शुरू करने के लिए।

en.intro: The Pandava conches sound, and the noise is so fierce it seems to shake the very ground. Listen for who it strikes.
en.body: That terrible sound split the hearts of Dhritarashtra's side, echoing through sky and earth. The word vyadarayat means to rip open or split. The sound of the Pandava conches rips open the hearts of Dhritarashtra's sons before a single weapon is lifted. Yet Arjuna, the source of this sound, does not stand in joy. He lifts his bow, ready to fight.
